config.betterloadingscreen.draw_backgrou: Draw a black gradient background, fading from bottom to top, behind the loading screen.
config.betterloadingscreen.i18n_loading_: Localize "LOADING...". For example, display "LOADING..." in English and "加载中..." in Chinese.
config.betterloadingscreen.animation_fra: The playback interval of the animation in the bottom right corner: the smaller the interval, the faster it plays. The larger the interval, the slower it plays.
